findings.claim: The default timeout is 12 seconds (DEFAULT_TIMEOUT_SECONDS). The override is 3 seconds for the 'health' endpoint, returned by timeout_for when endpoint == 'health'.
caveats: The override is hardcoded to 3 seconds within timeout_for; no configuration parameter controls it.
Client.request also accepts an explicit timeout parameter that supersedes both default and override (client.py:6).
